name: Serial Log Injection
comment: Gives plain *.log files (older recordings, or a custom saveLogAt naming that does not end in .serial.log) the same serial-specific colouring, layered on top of VS Code's built-in 'log' grammar rather than replacing it — the language indicator still reads 'Log'. Every rule it pulls in is anchored to the exact '[<timestamp> <MODE> <DIRECTION>]' header this extension writes, so an unrelated .log file a user happens to open is left entirely alone.
